title: RADV Xclipse
gpus: Samsung Xclipse 920 / 530 / 940. Chips: Exynos 2200, Exynos 1480, Exynos 2400 / 2400e (940 is experimental). Phones: Galaxy S22 / S22+ / S22 Ultra (Exynos models), Galaxy A55, Galaxy S24 / S24+ (Exynos models), Galaxy S24 FE. Not the Snapdragon versions of these phones, and not Exynos 1580 (Xclipse 540).
author: JimVulkan
note: The default RADV for Xclipse. Built from JimVulkan's v1.6.0-RC source (05b3092), paired with the author's v1.6.0-RC Android release. Kept as the default because testers measured the final v1.6.0 about 30% slower in FauxVkTest; newer releases (now v1.8.0) are the separate manual option RADV-Xclipse-upstream.

title: RADV-Xclipse (upstream v1.8.0)
gpus: Samsung Xclipse 920 / 530 / 940. Chips: Exynos 2200, Exynos 1480, Exynos 2400 / 2400e (940 is experimental). Phones: Galaxy S22 / S22+ / S22 Ultra (Exynos models), Galaxy A55, Galaxy S24 / S24+ (Exynos models), Galaxy S24 FE. Not the Snapdragon versions of these phones, and not Exynos 1580 (Xclipse 540).
author: JimVulkan
note: Manual option, not the default (the default is RADV-Xclipse, built from v1.6.0-RC, which testers measured faster). This is JimVulkan's v1.8.0 on Mesa 27.0.0-devel, both halves: everything in v1.6.0 (tessellation and transform feedback fixes, BC terrain-texture fix, less memory for BC7 and signed BC4/BC5), BC6H at half the memory (v1.7.0), and in v1.8.0 BC6H/BC7 loading about twice as fast, the BC6H signed/unsigned fix (wrong lighting in DXVK games) and unsigned BC4 at a third of the memory. Less texture memory matters on 8 GB phones, where heavy games were killed by Android for memory. Ray tracing is untested upstream. In the Linux half the author's Android properties do not exist; use RADV_XCLIPSE_BC7SRGB_RGBA8=1 (exact sRGB BC7) and RADV_XCLIPSE_BCSNORM_EXACT=1 (exact signed BC4/BC5) instead.

title: PanVK-kbase (zenithblue, all newer Mali: v9 to v13)
gpus: One driver for Mali v9 to v13 on Arm's kbase driver: G57 / G68 / G77 / G78 (v9), G610 / G710 (v10), G615 / G715 (v11), G720 (v12), G925 / G725 (v13). Author-tested (PanProbe 38/38): Lenovo Tab TB336FU (G57), Poco X6 Pro (G615), Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra (G720), Motorola Edge 40 Neo (G610), Pixel 7 / 7a (G710), Pixel 8 / 9 (G715); Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra (G925) passed on the previous beta. Chips include Helio G99, Dimensity 7300 / 8300 / 9000 / 9300 / 9400, Tensor G2 / G3 / G4. Android 15 or newer (the author's Android build needs API 35).
author: zenithblue-oss
note: The Linux half is built here from zenithblue's source at 9be6dd6 (2026-10-23, the RC5 work through csf-v11/222; the next patch, 226, needs a pool field only the JM series defines, so it does not build for this profile yet): Mali-G1-Ultra (v14) memory import fix, smaller tiler heaps and command pools (less memory), X11 surface and damage fixes, vkd3d fork-hang fix, plus this repo's three fixes (sync-file fd leak, provoking-vertex, DRM node). The Android half is the author's official RC4 lowmem (lowmem BC on by default; PANVK_BC_MODE turns it off). RC4's own source was not published, so the halves come from different builds of the same project.

title: FristOneRR PanVK (older Mali)
gpus: Older Mali (Job Manager): G52, G57, G68, G76, G77, G78. Chips: Helio G85 / G88 / G95 / G99 / G100, Dimensity 700 / 810 / 6020 / 6080 / 6100+ / 1080 / 1200 / 1300 / 8050, Kompanio 1300T, Unisoc T820, Exynos 1280 / 1380. Phones the author lists as working: Poco M6 Pro 4G, Galaxy A15 / A15 5G / A17 4G, Realme 10 4G, Infinix Note 30 5G / Note 50 Pro, Tecno Camon 20 Pro 5G, Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G, Redmi Note 10S, Galaxy Tab S9 FE+.
author: FristOneRR (credits: Noysz, mexicanbr0auth, LukeValen, BossDrk)
note: The Linux half is built from the newest public source (beta 1.2.0); the Android half is the official v3.5 release (installs on Android 9 and newer, the 3.0 bugs fixed including wrong lighting and colours, faster Unreal Engine 3/4 games, ASTC/ETC1/ETC2 textures), pinned. The author recommends FristOneRR-Wrapper 3.0 for Android apps.

title: PanVK G720 (wonderkast02)
gpus: Mali-G720 (CSF). Chips: Dimensity 9300 / 9300+, Dimensity 8400. Phones/tablets: Vivo X100 / X100 Pro, Oppo Find X7, Galaxy Tab S10+ / S10 Ultra, Poco X7 Pro, Redmi Turbo 4.
author: wonderkast02
note: The Linux half is built from the g720-development branch; the Android half is the official 0.1.0-beta.2 release.

title: PanVK kbase Android (G615)
gpus: Mali-G615 (CSF). Chips: Dimensity 7300 (the author's test phone is an Oppo CPH2763), Dimensity 8300. Phones: Poco X6 Pro, Redmi K70E and other Dimensity 7300 / 8300 phones.
author: GunaCharanTeja (fork of zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android)
note: Built from the author's 1.1.5-FC tag: 1.1.4-FC (RDR1 GPU-fault fixes, fewer GPU queue stalls, 8 MiB tiler heap chunks) plus BC textures transcoded at their native size (BC1-3 to ETC2, BC4/BC5 to EAC: about half the texture memory) and faster BC6H/BC7 conversion. PANVK_BC_ETC=0 / PANVK_BC_EAC=0 bring back 1.1.4's texture paths. The author's own Android release is for adrenotools/X11 apps; the Android half here is built from the same tag and patches as the Linux half.

title: PanVK kbase Android (G610 / G710, experimental)
gpus: Mali-G610 / G710 (CSF, arch v10). Chips: Google Tensor G2 and Dimensity 9000 / 9000+ (Mali-G710), Dimensity 7200 / 8000 / 8100 / 8200 (Mali-G610). Devices: Pixel 7 / 7 Pro / 7a, Pixel Fold, Pixel Tablet, OnePlus Nord 3, Nothing Phone (2a), Redmi Note 13 Pro+.
author: GunaCharanTeja (fork of zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android)
note: Built from the project's g610-v10-csf profile, which its author marks as planned and not yet validated. The G710 is the same GPU generation. No official Android release exists; the Android half will be built here.

title: PanVK faux123 (Retroid Pocket 4 Pro)
gpus: Retroid Pocket 4 Pro only (Dimensity 1100, Mali-G77 MC9). Tuned and tested by the author on that handheld.
author: faux123
note: Mixed pair. The Android half is faux123's own v1.1.3 build, unchanged: one universal driver for all his devices (the same package in all his repositories), built on zenithblue's v0.1.0-rc4 (5b87b74) plus 76 of his patches. v1.1.3 fixes "device lost" from register spilling (WWE '12) and passes 1,674 Vulkan conformance tests with spilling forced. His patches are in a private repo, so it cannot be rebuilt for Linux. The Linux half is our zenithblue PanVK-kbase build (same project, newer source).
